translations.web: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
translations.bsb: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
translations.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
translations.asv: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
